text: ASTLEY DOWN, Nov. 13 — The annual Larkmere kite festival is held in Astley Down, people familiar with the matter said. The three-day event, scheduled this year for June 7-9, draws about 18,000 visitors to the town’s north field and riverfront promenade, according to organizers briefed on the plans. This year’s program is expected to include a night-lights launch, a junior design contest and a memorial flight honoring founder Elise Varr. Local officials said parking capacity will be expanded by 12% and shuttle service from Bracken Station will run every 15 minutes. The festival has been staged in Astley Down for 24 years, said people familiar with the matter.
